notes: GeoChem Explorer 0.3.3 adds drill planning, regional prospectivity and structural discs, and an AI assistant that works in your project, in its own window or through Claude Desktop, Claude Code or Codex (30-day free trial). Snapping is one setting for every tool, sections can be drawn at a set azimuth, and large LiDAR surfaces load as grids. Input updates merge by hole. Large projects open with less memory. Projects re-import once on first open.
